forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
In week 27 of July, 4 survey teams and 4 clearance teams were active. Teams completed 1 zone survey and 2 visits; no technical surveys or clearances were completed. So far, 19 zones have been surveyed, 6 declared free, 15 areas released, and 8 cleared. Mines have been found in 5 areas.

No teams were stood down or had reports overdue by more than a week. No dossiers or reports were held or queried. The access feed shows 13 zones closed. New plan P07 was approved this week. There are 575 suspected or confirmed areas still open.

For the zones of the plan the forecast was made with, counting what is done already, the P10 to P90 range is 11 to 15 mine areas cleared this season and 8 to 10 zones declared free this season.
